agreed_facts.text: Russia detained or arrested a Japanese journalist on allegations of spying or espionage.
The journalist was detained in Russia's far east, specifically on Sakhalin island or in the Sakhalin region.
The journalist works for the Hokkaido Shimbun newspaper.
The detention was announced by Russia's security service, the FSB.
The journalist is accused of collecting information on Russia's defences or military.

headline_quotes.quote: where he had been reporting on military recruitment

emphasis.text: Leads with Japan's diplomatic protest, including the summoning of Russia's ambassador.
Notes the journalist had been reporting on military recruitment in the far east.
Attributes the spying allegation to the FSB security agency.

headline_quotes.quote: Moscow warns Tokyo's information gathering attempts will strain ties
amid a spike in tensions between Russia and Japan

emphasis.text: Leads with Russian Foreign Ministry spokesperson Maria Zakharova's warning that Tokyo's use of correspondents to gather information will strain relations.
Places the arrest in the context of tensions following Putin's August trip to the disputed Kuril Islands.
Attributes the accusation of gathering defence information to the FSB or Moscow.
